title: PolicyConfig
description: A policy file. Every key is optional; a missing file has no rules.

allow.description:
Actions that run without asking, unless a deny or ask rule, guard, or hook says
otherwise.

ask.description: Actions that always need a human, even where an allow rule matches.

deny.description: Hard denies: no later rule, hook, or mode can allow what these match.

PolicyRule.description: One rule. It matches an action if any of its patterns does, in the modes it lists.

exec.description:
Globs over the command's space-joined argv; `*` matches any run of characters and
`\*` a literal `*`.

modes.description: Modes the rule applies in; every mode when unset.

reason.description: Shown to the human and the agent when the rule decides.

paths.description: Gitignore-style globs over repo-relative paths, added to the built-in list.
